tree.heading: In General.—
tree.text: The Regular Space Force is the component of the Space Force that consists of persons whose continuous service on active duty in both peace and war is contemplated by law, and of retired members of the Regular Space Force.

children.text: the officers and enlisted members of the Regular Space Force; and
the retired officers and enlisted members of the Regular Space Force.

notes.heading: Repeal of Section
notes.text: Pub. L. 118–31, div. A, title XVII, § 1735(c), Dec. 22, 2023, 137 Stat. 677, provided that, effective on the date on which the certification by the Secretary of the Air Force is submitted under section 1735(a) of Pub. L. 118–31, this section is repealed.

notes.heading: Prior Provisions
notes.text: A prior section 9086 was renumbered section 9087 of this title.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 2024—Pub. L. 118–159 renumbered section 9085 of this title as this section.

notes.heading: Effective Date of Repeal
notes.text: Repeal effective on the date on which the certification by the Secretary of the Air Force is submitted under section 1735(a) of Pub. L. 118–31, see section 1735(c)(2) of Pub. L. 118–31, set out in a Transitions Provisions note under section 20001 of this title.
